Mina Chen: Quick recap from today's all-hands — thanks everyone. I'll drop slides and a concise list of clarifications + owners.
Sam Ortiz: Thanks Mina! Slides: https://notion.redwood.ai/allhands/2333
Mina Chen: TL;DR: 1) Dedicated GA target moved to May 17 (tentative). 2) Private pilot: 3 customers starting June. 3) Console retention increase pushed to Q3.
Raj Patel: Question — do we have SLO numbers for Dedicated GA? Mina, can you confirm?
Mina Chen: Raj — yes. Target p95 latency 200ms for 8k token workloads. SLA draft here: https://go.redwood/ga-sla
Emily Zhao: Action: I'll own finalizing SLA language. ETA Thu 05/02. @Emily Zhao :raising_hand:
Sam Ortiz: Ops follow-up: need a migration runbook for existing Dedicated customers. @Jon can you lead?
Jon: Yep. I'll open a runbook PR this week. ETA next Wed. Will ping #eng-runtime when ready.
Mina Chen: Rollout policy: canary -> amplified canary -> global. Auto-fallback to quantized model on capacity pressure.
Raj Patel: Who's doing the quantization test matrix? I can take it if no one else volunteers.
Mina Chen: Ok assigning: Emily (SLA), Jon (runbook), Raj (quant testing), Sam (customer comms). I added checkboxes in the Notion page.
deploy-bot: New page created by Mina: https://notion.redwood.ai/ah/what-next-roster
Mina Chen: Quick ask to owners: please confirm ownership by EOD tomorrow. If you need more time, say so here or book 15m with me.
Sam Ortiz: FYI — draft customer comms is in the doc. Feedback welcome.
Emily Zhao: Noted, will review and comment by EOD.
Raj Patel: Starting test matrix today, will share results link by Monday.
Mina Chen: Thanks all — I'll post an action summary once owners confirm. :white_check_mark:
Sam Ortiz: :thumbsup:
